operating_notes.text: Power & fuel expense was ₹37.24 Cr in Q1FY27, 44% of revenue, up from ₹25.20 Cr a year ago.
The company has committed to invest 100% of the paid-up share capital in a UAE-registered entity that will become a wholly owned subsidiary.
FY26 consolidated revenue was ₹304.90 Cr, of which India was ₹302.12 Cr (99%) and exports ₹2.78 Cr.
Contingent liabilities at 31-Mar-2026 were ₹123.93 Cr, including ₹64.60 Cr of indirect tax (GST) demands and ₹39.71 Cr EPCG obligation.
The company availed ₹7.50 Cr from Cosmos Bank for a solar project at Goral for Talod during FY26.

timeline.summary: Q1FY27 (Jul 2026): Exxaro Tiles reported consolidated revenue of ₹85.22 Cr (+31% YoY) and PAT of ₹2.07 Cr, and set its 19th AGM for 26 September 2026.
2026-08-31: Filed 19th Annual Report for FY26 — unmodified audit with an emphasis of matter on the UAE subsidiary, ₹123.93 Cr contingent liabilities and ₹6.57 Cr of MD loans outstanding.

Exxaro Tiles Ltd’s 19th AGM held on **26-Sep-2026** via VC/OAVM, chaired by **Mukeshbhai B. Patel**, with **46 shareholders** and **7 directors/KMPs** present, including **Jigneshbhai Patel (CFO)** and **Dharmishtha Shah (Company Secretary).
Exxaro Tiles Ltd’s 19th AGM (26.09.2026) passed adoption of standalone & consolidated financials for FY2026 via e-voting with 99.92% approval.
